text:
mariam: Heads-up — we need to finalize v2.14 rollout windows for US / EU / APAC and lock the changelog cutoff. Please confirm availability and any constraints.
aj: How long do we expect partial disruptions? Any DB work planned?
karen: No DB migrations. This is config + model swap only. Plan is zero-downtime with staged traffic.
sam: Proposed cadence (UTC, canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%, 15m between steps):
```
US:   04:00 - 07:00 UTC
EU:   12:00 - 15:00 UTC
APAC: 22:00 - 01:00 UTC
```
liam: Those windows mostly avoid business hours. APAC end at 01:00 UTC lines up with late morning in parts of APAC though — might be annoying for local on-call.
mariam: We can shift APAC to 23:00 - 02:00 UTC if that helps. Who's on APAC rotation?
karen: I can cover APAC handover 23:00-02:00 UTC. SRE will be available for rollback.
aj: Changelog cutoff suggestion: 16:00 UTC today to give release engineers time to build and sanity-check artifacts. OK?
sam: 16:00 UTC cutoff works for engineering. Any PRs that need to be held back?
omar: Active PRs for this release: #4213 (perf), #4299 (metrics), #4334 (minor docs). #4334 can wait; #4299 needs the feature flag toggle before merge.
liam: Branch plan: create release/v2.14 from main at 19:00 UTC. CI will run full e2e + perf checks on that branch.
mariam: Tentative timeline:
- 16:00 UTC: changelog cutoff
- 19:00 UTC: branch created + CI kicks off
- 21:30 UTC: artifacts built and tagged
- 04:00 UTC: start US rollout
Please ack with :thumbsup: if you can cover your region windows.
karen: :thumbsup: (APAC on-call)
aj: :thumbsup: (US rollback owner)
omar: :thumbsup: (watching deploy logs)
sre-bot: Deploy queue updated: release/v2.14 -> canary pool. CI pipelines: running.
sam: Important: default feature flags for new-model-logging must be OFF at rollout. Enable after 50% if metrics stable.
liam: Automated guardrail: if token latency regresses > 12% or error rate > 0.5% in canary, pipeline auto-aborts and opens incident in #incidents.
mariam: Rollback leads: @karen takes APAC/EU, @aj takes US. Can someone paste a minimal rollback snippet here?
omar: Will paste rollback steps before 18:45 UTC. Minimal: revert traffic, undo model-swap, re-apply previous config, validate health checks.
stefanie: I'll notify Customer Success and prepare the customer-facing note to send post-tag. Template ready.
liam: Also note: CDN TTLs for model assets are 3600s — expect up to 1 hour for cache propagation. That shouldn't block rollout but be aware.
mariam: Final check: any outstanding schema or migration PRs? I thought we deferred #4250.
omar: Confirmed deferred — no schema changes.
sam: I'll update release checklist and post the changelog draft to #releases at 16:05 UTC.
mariam: Thanks. If anything changes, update this thread. This will be the authoritative timeline for the rollout.
